project.name: Milton of Balgonie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 14 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Balgonie Castle is separately related context and does not lift the town score. Village-hall parking and toilets are not general public visitor facilities. Markinch services are outside the settlement.
